title: Bhippi plugin manifest (schema 2)
description: manifest.json of a .bhippi-plugin package (src/plugins/package.ts). The app and the marketplace both check it; manifest.lock.json pins the SHA-256 of every other file in the package.

bhippi.description: Bhippi versions it works with: space-separated conditions such as ">=1.0.0 <2", "^1.2.0", "~1.2.0".

tools.description: Bhippi tools the plugin calls that change something. "*" covers editing tools but never sensitive ones (shell, files, deletes, memory, network through Bhippi, paid generation, MCP servers), which must be named.

network.description: Hosts the plugin may connect to: example.com, *.example.com, https://api.example.com:8443.

chat.description: May suggest messages for Bhippi AI; each reaches the AI only when the user clicks Send.
